sewer-throughput-b7b0053b62e47219bbda.rationale: Reviewed complete positive-reference sewer-throughput service per one cubic metre wastewater conveyed. Source rural and urban inventories are already normalized per cubic metre; retain every original material, machine, electricity, disposal and direct water quantity. The stated 100-year lifetime and renovation after 70 years are already incorporated; no second lifetime, capacity, pipe-length or litre conversion is applied. These are sewer infrastructure services, not wastewater treatment or kilometre sewer construction. Positive product and conversion-only inputs keep factor +1; negative waste references require factor -1 independently. Retain the original regional supply weights without renormalization. Complete UVEK material and operating suppliers are screening proxies: Swiss/European cement/mortar and concrete blends, cast-iron and steel production mixes, gravel and sand supply, electricity mix, diesel machines, water delivery, full HDPE/PP/emulsion-PVC resin and separate pipe extrusion differ in background, freight, vintage and technology. The source synthetic-rubber producers and UVEK product both include EPDM profile extrusion and vulcanisation; retain the source separate plastic-pipe extrusion demand without adding a second rubber conversion. Disposal uses the existing independently sign-reviewed component correspondences and inherits their treatment-route, regional, waste composition, moisture and freight approximations; the Swiss services do not reconstruct original country-specific disposal mixes. The exact 3.9.1 and 3.10.1 polyethylene-waste market groups retains its RER/Europe-without-Switzerland/Swiss weights using the existing country-market correspondences; no inheritance from 3.10 and no global polyethylene rule rewrite. These helpers do not establish LCIA equivalence. Preserve the separate reported water releases in cubic metres; native UVEK uses the existing reviewed 1000 kg/m3 correspondence without altering compartments. No real emission is omitted. Score/export all helpers. Preserve caller amounts, uncertainty, formulas, metadata, foreground suppliers, production and separately listed emissions; internal source uncertainty and parameter formulas are not reconstructed. Only enumerated exact cut-off profiles are approved. No patch, version, model, capacity-class fallback, global supplier replacement or reverse sewer-throughput correspondence is inferred.

sewer-throughput-5ad254f2a66ab4151737.rationale: Reviewed complete positive-reference sewer-throughput service per one cubic metre wastewater conveyed. Source rural and urban inventories are already normalized per cubic metre; retain every original material, machine, electricity, disposal and direct water quantity. The stated 100-year lifetime and renovation after 70 years are already incorporated; no second lifetime, capacity, pipe-length or litre conversion is applied. These are sewer infrastructure services, not wastewater treatment or kilometre sewer construction. Positive product and conversion-only inputs keep factor +1; negative waste references require factor -1 independently. Retain the original regional supply weights without renormalization. Complete UVEK material and operating suppliers are screening proxies: Swiss/European cement/mortar and concrete blends, cast-iron and steel production mixes, gravel and sand supply, electricity mix, diesel machines, water delivery, full HDPE/PP/emulsion-PVC resin and separate pipe extrusion differ in background, freight, vintage and technology. The source synthetic-rubber producers and UVEK product both include EPDM profile extrusion and vulcanisation; retain the source separate plastic-pipe extrusion demand without adding a second rubber conversion. Disposal uses the existing independently sign-reviewed component correspondences and inherits their treatment-route, regional, waste composition, moisture and freight approximations; the Swiss services do not reconstruct original country-specific disposal mixes. The exact 3.9.1 and 3.10.1 polyethylene-waste market groups retains its RER/Europe-without-Switzerland/Swiss weights using the existing country-market correspondences; no inheritance from 3.10 and no global polyethylene rule rewrite. These helpers do not establish LCIA equivalence. Preserve the separate reported water releases in cubic metres; native UVEK uses the existing reviewed 1000 kg/m3 correspondence without altering compartments. No real emission is omitted. Score/export all helpers. Preserve caller amounts, uncertainty, formulas, metadata, foreground suppliers, production and separately listed emissions; internal source uncertainty and parameter formulas are not reconstructed. Only enumerated exact cut-off profiles are approved. No patch, version, model, capacity-class fallback, global supplier replacement or reverse sewer-throughput correspondence is inferred.

reviews.rationale: Reconstruct the exact3.9cutoff pig-iron wastewater market as a positive physical service, factor-1 from its negative1m3 waste reference. Preserve original rural/urban sewer-throughput quantities, the original treated fraction, and every separate untreated water/pollutant discharge with its signed amount, original surface-water compartment and units. Use complete native Swiss class3 pig-iron effluent treatment only for the treated fraction. Native documented COD0.0000203kg/m3 versus source0.00002kg/m3 does not establish equal pollutant inventories; no COD or efficiency rescaling is inferred. The native treatment includes deterministic class3 sewer infrastructure: subtract exactly that embedded length times treated fraction from the same native supplier to prevent double counting with retained source sewer services. This negative correction is bookkeeping, not avoided sewer construction or a physical recovery credit. Native treatment retains all other inputs/emissions and embeds sludge handling. Treatment technology, plant capacity, geography, vintage, internal uncertainty, biosphere exclusions and LCIA scores can differ; effects unquantified. Existing separately reviewed sewer-throughput reconstructions and their documented material, freight, operation and native-supply proxies apply unchanged. No full-volume treatment approximation, renormalization, omitted untreated release, extra treatment, network lifetime multiplier, kg/m3 conversion, moisture correction or cross-system-model route. Preserve caller signs, supported uncertainty, formulas and separate foreground emissions. Only exact independently inspected3.9cutoff profiles qualify; other releases and reverse routes remain unapproved.
